mentions.name: homeassistant.koplugin
mentions.description: A KOReader plugin that lets users control Home Assistant entities directly from the open-source ebook reader without leaving the book they are reading. The author has iterated on it for almost a year, shifting from adding many features toward keeping it simple and avoiding unnecessary complexity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a small KOReader (an open-source ebook reader software) plugin that lets you control Home Assistant entities without leaving your current book.
